highlights: The Green Lion Crystal Clear Case for Samsung S25 ULTRA  is an ideal product if you want protection from scratches and want to show off how beautiful your phone is.
The case has a transparent and stylish design that is also manufactured from an anti-yellowing material, guaranteeing it will look clean and give off the same clarity throughout its use.
The case is compatible with S25 Ultra.
The cutouts are accurate, enabling access to all the ports and buttons.
The Green Lion Crystal Clear Case is anti-scratch, which is helpful because there is more concern about how the device looks. Which further helps the device during accidental drops.
